reguloj.name: semantic-colors-alias-palette
reguloj.statement: Semantic color tokens reference palette tokens instead of literal values.
reguloj.kialo: A palette change then reaches every semantic use in one place.

reguloj.name: sekundo-not-action
reguloj.statement: No action, link or focus role aliases the Zweitfarbe: color.action.*, color.link.* and color.focus.* never alias a step of color.palette.sekundo or a role of color.sekundo, in any set.
reguloj.kialo: The lead colour marks what can be done; a second colour on actions would make two kinds of action.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.action.*, color.link.*, color.focus.* in every set
